decisions.series: Series 1 and 2 combined in one equally available Base pool; 462 cards; #7 retired and absent.
decisions.variations: One canonical #220 McGwire and one #461 Sosa; no separate home-run variation odds.
decisions.packs: VCS four cards per pack, 24 packs per box (not historical packaging).
decisions.insertOdds: Historic odds noted where known; Series-specific or format-specific probabilities require final normalization prior to release.
decisions.mvp: 416-card TCDB MVP promotional partial parallel represented as its own set; historical weekly redemption process not simulated.
decisions.exclusions: Two oversized box-topper sets, MVP Exchange mail-in, and pre-production promotional samples excluded from ordinary pack ripping.
decisions.release: Draft only, no pricing or product publication.
